tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: $0.01 per call — Fetch a public URL and return status, final URL, title, cleaned text (scripts/styles stripped, truncated) and the top 20 absolute links. Useful when an agent itself cannot reach the open web.

tools.name: domain_intel
tools.description: $0.02 per call — Domain due-diligence bundle: RDAP registrar + creation/expiry dates + status, DNS records (A/MX/NS/TXT), and Certificate Transparency history via crt.sh. Use to vet a domain before trusting or linking to it.

tools.name: github_repo
tools.description: $0.02 per call — GitHub repo snapshot: stars, forks, open-issue count, watchers, primary language, SPDX license, created/pushed dates and latest release tag. Use to triage a repo before contributing or depending on it.

tools.name: token_intel
tools.description: $0.02 per call — Base ERC-20 due-diligence: on-chain name, symbol, decimals and total supply via eth_call. Use to sanity-check a Base token address before interacting with it.

tools.name: repo_diligence
tools.description: $2.5 per call — Deep GitHub repo due-diligence: base snapshot + last 5 commits (author/date/message), contributor count, archived flag, security-policy presence, latest release cadence and open/closed issue ratio. Use to decide whether to depend on or contribute to a repo before trusting it.

tools.name: web_brief
tools.description: $3 per call — Multi-source research brief from 1–3 URLs. For each source extract title, meta description, key sentences (numbered/quoted/date-or-figure-bearing) and outbound links. Returns a structured, citable brief other agents can consume without their own web access.

tools.name: free_url_check
tools.description: FREE — FREE: check whether a public URL is reachable and what it is. Returns HTTP status, final URL after redirects, content type and page title. Use web_fetch (paid) for full text and links.
